subject: Deployment mode and compliance requirements - Elara Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment mode options and next steps (HIPAA/SOC2)

Hi Tom / Sarah,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of your requirements I heard today:
- PHI in scope, must sign a BAA and meet HIPAA obligations
- SOC2 Type II evidence required for your security review
- Audit log retention and searchable traces for at least 1 year
- Encryption at rest and in transit; KMS integration preferred
- Expected production peak ~30 QPS, 100k tokens/day initially; low single-digit p99 latency needs for inference (~200-500ms)

Redwood deployment options that match those needs:
1) Hosted API + BAA: fastest time to value; we offer a Hosted API with a BAA and controls (role-based access, encryption, audit logs). Good for pilots.
2) Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools in your region with tenant isolation (recommended for predictable throughput and better network isolation).
3) Private VPC / On-prem: Full private deployment if you require customer-managed networking and strict data residency.

Immediate ask / next steps:
- I will share our SOC2 Type II report and BAA draft (attached) for your legal/compliance review.
- Please confirm whether you prefer we start with Hosted (fastest) or run a Dedicated pilot for initial production testing.
- If Dedicated/Private, can you share a rough timeline for procurement and who from your infra/legal teams we should loop in?
- Can you also send the completed security questionnaire (if you have one). I've attached a BAA and will add the SOC2 report now.

Attachments: SOC2_report_2026.pdf (Redwood), BAA_template_Redwood_vElara.docx

I'm available to jump on a follow-up call next week to walk legal through the BAA and technical team through architecture and log access. Proposed times: Tue/Wed 10-12 PT.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@elarahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode options and next steps (HIPAA/SOC2)

Dylan, thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our side (legal & procurement copied):

1) Hosted + BAA: is data processed on shared infrastructure? Will PHI ever touch multi-tenant GPUs/storage that are not logically separated? Our security team prefers dedicated tenancy for PHI unless there are strong mitigation controls.
2) Audit logs: what fields are logged (request/response latencies, token-level traces, requestor identity, model version)? Can we get S3 access to logs or do you push to a SIEM?
3) KMS: do you support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed keys?
4) SOC2: appreciate you sharing the report. Is there a penetration test summary we can include?
5) Timeline: procurement will need 6-8 weeks if Dedicated or Private is selected. For a pilot, Hosted could work if our legal approves the BAA.

We attached our security questionnaire. We'd like to schedule a technical deep dive with your infra team next week (Wed morning PT preferred).

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
Elara Health

Attachment: Elara_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode options and next steps (HIPAA/SOC2)

Tom,

Thanks for the questions; answers below. Happy to cover any of this on the deep-dive Wed.

1) Hosted + BAA: Hosted runs on pooled hardware but with strong logical tenancy controls. For PHI we recommend Dedicated in most cases because it provides physical GPU pool isolation and predictable performance. Hosted + BAA is acceptable for pilot/proof-of-concept if your legal is comfortable with logical controls; we have customers who run PHI on Hosted under a BAA, but we'll leave that call to your compliance team.

2) Audit logs: We capture request metadata (timestamp, request-id, model version, input size, latency p50/p90/p99), user identity (API key or service principal), and delivery status. We intentionally do not store full response bodies by default unless configured for debugging (redacted options exist). We can push logs to your SIEM (S3 + CloudTrail integration or direct syslog).

3) KMS: We support customer-managed KMS keys in cloud KMS providers and HSM-backed keys for dedicated/private deployments. For Hosted we can integrate with your KMS for encryption-at-rest in some regions or use our KMS with strict key separation and access controls.

4) Pentest: We can share a high-level penetration test summary (non-sensitive executive summary) and our SOC2 report. Full test artifacts are shared under NDA/secure portal.

5) Timeline: totally reasonable, Dedicated/procurement 6-8 weeks is typical. For faster time-to-value, we often start customers on Hosted under a BAA for a 30-60 day pilot, then migrate to Dedicated for production.

Proposed next steps:
- I've attached SOC2_report_2026.pdf and the BAA template.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive Wed 10:00-11:00 PT, I'll invite our infra lead (Neha) and Marissa (sales lead) to cover legal/contract questions.
- If you'd like a Dedicated sizing, share expected QPS and concurrency patterns (you mentioned 30 QPS, please confirm peak burst).
- I will also open a HubSpot deal and attach these materials (ELARA-1792).

DocuSign BAA (preview): https://docusign.net/Elara-Redwood-BAA
HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ELARA-1792

Best,
Dylan
